I can't confirm that for the whole period. The evidence is insufficient because of a temporal gap.

**What was found:** NASA FIRMS thermal detections (MODIS and the three VIIRS sensors: SNPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) show zero detections intersecting the asset from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24.

**What's missing:** All four sensors lack coverage for 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25. This is because that day came after the latest near-real-time file update (the day was in progress or not yet published). So the final day of the 2026-09-25/2026-10-25 period was not evaluated.

**Caveats:** Even for the covered days, zero detections doesn't prove no fire occurred. Small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area or about dates outside the period.

Re-running the check once the NRT data for the last day is published would close the gap.
